title.narrative: East Jerusalem Hospitals (EJH) - PEGASE support to the Palestinian Authority with a financial contribution to partially cover the outstanding invoices of medical referrals to East Jerusalem hospitals-2023

description.narrative: Contract related to: East Jerusalem Hospitals (EJH) - PEGASE support to the Palestinian Authority with a financial contribution to partially cover the outstanding invoices of medical referrals to East Jerusalem hospitals-2023 - The PEGASE programme aims at contributing to a democratic, accountable, economically viable Palestinian state as well as the fulfilment of social rights. The specific objectives are: (1) improved access to social public services for all, women, girls, men and boys; and (2) improved inclusiveness, effectiveness, efficiency and transparency in policy making and budgeting. The action's induced outputs are underpinned by the following direct outputs: eased financing for social public services; enhanced administrative and technical capacity of the Palestinian Authority (PA) institutions; improved coordination with government, development partners and Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) for enhanced policy dialogue at global and sector level.The overall contribution of the EU for 2023 amounts to EUR 238 400 000. Key components of this action are: a contribution to the payments of the Salaries and Pensions of civil servants (CSP, EUR 205 000 000); a contribution to the social allowances for vulnerable families (Cash Transfer Programme ¿ CTP, EUR 0 000 000); a contribution to the payment for the medical referrals to the East Jerusalem Hospitals (EJH, EUR 18 000 000, including additional 5 000 0000); safeguard measures (EUR 550,000); support the administrative and technical capacity of the PA institutions (EUR 13 000 000) including 5 000 000 to expand and improve quality of care and diversify revenues for better financial sustainability with focus on Al Makassed and Augusta Victoria hospitals and EUR 1 850 000 for contingencies.An additional amount of EUR 110 million is added to Civil Servantsand Pensioners (CSP) that will be paid urgently in line with the normal PEGASE procedures and safeguards. EU contribution to PA¿s salaries will be part of the emergency package the Commissionhas prepared for the macro fiscal stabilisation of the Palestinian Authority over the period of July-September 2024.
